path: m(N)=(1-N)m_initial+N*m_final; mT(N)=N*mT_final; real carrier locked to local material angle. Both endpoints are actual free-domain equilibria from PC. This is a restricted diagnostic curve, not the solved dynamics.
derivation: Continuity fixes radial total flux=-Ndot delta_M(<r). Cauchy-Schwarz gives sum rho_i v_i² >= total_flux²/(r^4 rho_total), hence T>=Ndot² integral delta_M²/(r²rho)dr/2. Integrate the resulting maximum speed using the largest possible kinetic energy on this curve.
non_claims: No exclusion of different paths, local fronts, bursts or nonadiabatic density evolution
Energy bound is for the explicitly prescribed density interpolation
An inaccessible curve has no actual finite transit; quoted minimum time is a conditional lower bound, not a prediction
Endpoint halo has the previous K30, not the new virial-reference entropy
